abstract: On 31 August, SMPTE+ presented a seminar on migrating media into the cloud co-chaired by consultant Sally Hubbard and Deluxe senior vice president of innovation Richard Welsh. SMPTE executive director Barbara Lange and president Hans Hoffman opened the event, making note of the increased pace of migrating to the cloud as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic. The seminar focused on the challenges that remain, as the media & entertainment (M&E) industry continues with the migration.
